newsitem.title: USA: LG&E offers to buy or lease Big Rivers.
newsitem.headline: LG&E offers to buy or lease Big Rivers.

text.p: LG&E Energy Corp said Monday it submitted a proposal to directors of Big Rivers Electric Corp to lease or acquire the assets of the Henderson, Ky,-based power cooperative.
The proposal outlines two alternative plans to Big Rivers, which is in bankruptcy proceedings and has proposed a reorganization in conjunction with PacifiCorp.
Under the first plan, LG&E Energy would lease the power generation assets of Big Rivers for 25 years and provide power to Big Rivers' member cooperatives at reduced rates.

That proposal mirrors the transaction structure outlined in Big Rivers' reorganization plan filed with the bankruptcy court on January 22, but provides $35 million in rate reductions to Big Rivers and an additional $2 million to be distributed to its unsecured creditors, LG&E said.

Under the second proposal, the company said, it would acquire all assets, properties and contracts not rejected in the plan. The purchase alternative would provide the same economic value to creditors as LG&E Energy's lease option, but provides $50 million in rate reductions to customers.

LG&E Energy has indicated to the Big Rivers board that, based upon the information available through the bankruptcy proceedings, both proposals offer greater benefit to Big Rivers but that the purchase option offers more certainty to Big Rivers' customers.
LG&E Energy said it requested that Big Rivers' board respond to the bid by February 17.

On January 22, Big Rivers spokeswoman Susan Sauls said the company has a February 19 court date to report on the status of talks with coal suppliers and the preparation of a rate case filing. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
